content: {"like":["Enjoys classic cartoon slapstick like Tom & Jerry’s energetic chases","Prefers high‑contrast, cinematic animation styles seen in Samurai Jack","Values complete series collections, especially for nostalgic shows like Rugrats","Appreciates claymation detail and storytelling in Laika films","Loves vibrant, contemporary cartoons such as Gumball and Hey Arnold!"],"dislike":["Dislikes inconsistent audio levels across episodes in older cartoons","Finds incomplete episode sets frustrating, especially limited Tom & Jerry releases","Criticizes mislabeling and errors in DVD packaging, e.g., Rugrats Season 3 disc mix‑up","Prefers full season box sets over piecemeal releases, as with Gumball Volume 3","Shows low enthusiasm for cartoons lacking strong thematic depth, e.g., Garbage Pail Kids"]}
